terra.problem: The cookie-timer joke makes the message Elisha gives, including what the LORD showed him, the target of the humor.
Saying that fleeing would give the king a chance adds an unsupported claim about what fleeing could accomplish.
The text says Elisha stared steadily until Hazael became uncomfortable, but it does not say the stare was long.
Forty camel loads describes the size of the gift, not how many camels were present.
The passage does not say Elisha was the only prophet in the scene.
